title: Craftable drill
description: A simple server-side plugin that adds a craftable 3x3 mining drill.
body:
Description:                                                                                           
                                                                                                         
  A simple Paper plugin that adds a craftable 3x3 mining drill.                                          
   
  Crafting Recipe:                                                                                       
  Crafted like a normal pickaxe — 3 Netherite Ingots across the top       and 2 Breeze Rods down the middle.   
  
   Features:                                                                                              
  - Mines a 3x3 area based on the face you're looking at
  - Sneak to mine a single block                                                                         
  - Respects block protection from other plugins (WorldGuard, etc.)
  - Netherite pickaxe stats (speed, durability, enchantability)                                          
  - No commands, no config — just craft and mine                                                         
                                                                                                         
  Compatibility:                                                                                         
  - Paper 1.21 — 1.21.11                                                                                 
  - Server-side only — no client mods needed
